subject: On‑prem observability: evidence package + SIEM ingestion questions
messages:
From: Jake Morris <jake.morris@acme-finance.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-finance.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability evidence and SIEM integration details for on‑prem Redwood deployment

Hi Kim,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. As we kick off our audit prep for an on‑prem/private deployment, the external audit team requested a consolidated evidence packet showing how logs, metrics, and traces will be exported from the Redwood appliance and consumed by our SIEM.

Specifically they asked for: 
- sample log batches and expected fields (syslog/JSON examples)
- retention & routing model for telemetry leaving the VPC
- how trace hooks correlate to request ids and the format we can forward to our APM/SIEM
- a manifest listing files/artifacts we can pull into the evidence repository

Can you share an initial package or a short checklist we can hand to our auditors? I've attached our internal SIEM requirements doc so you can map expectations. Ideally we want something we can place into the auditor evidence vault by next Wednesday (2026‑05‑27).

Thanks — Jake

Attachments: acme_siem_requirements_v1.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jake Morris <jake.morris@acme-finance.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability evidence and SIEM integration details for on‑prem Redwood deployment

Hi Jake —

Appreciate the clear list. We've started assembling a vendor evidence bundle that maps to each audit ask. High level plan: 

1) Samples 
- syslog/JSON examples (auth, inference, routing) — located in the evidence bundle as sample_logs/*.json
- trace export example (OpenTelemetry span->SIEM event mapping) — sample_traces/trace_example.json

2) Retention & routing 
- short doc that describes retention windows, on‑box cache, and egress controls for VPC/on‑prem deployments (see link below).

3) Correlation 
- we will include a small mapping doc that shows how request_id / kv_cache_id / model_shard are surfaced in spans and log lines so your APM can join traces with logs.

4) Manifest 
- evidence_manifest.csv will enumerate files and checksums.

Deliverable timeline: we can produce an initial bundle (zipped) by Tue 2026‑05‑26 EOD, which should give you time to upload to the auditor vault by Wed. Diego will own the bundle assembly and Hannah will add the retention/architectural note.

Quick asks for us to finalize: 
- which SIEM ingestion endpoint AND what concentration model you expect (push via HTTPS, pull via SFTP, or Splunk HEC). Your attached doc references both HEC and a Syslog forwarder — if you can confirm preferred ingestion we’ll tailor the examples.
- confirm the minimum fields your auditors need for logs (we default to time, request_id, trace_id, model, user_id (hashed), level, message).

Link to draft folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq-sample-evidence (view only for external).

I attached the manifest template to this reply.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Observability Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_manifest.csv (CSV, 5KB)

From: Jake Morris <jake.morris@acme-finance.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-finance.com
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability evidence and SIEM integration details for on‑prem Redwood deployment

Thanks Kim — that timeline works. Quick clarifications: 

On Mon, May 22, 2026 at 11:08 AM kimberly_park@redwood.com wrote:
> Quick asks for us to finalize:
> - which SIEM ingestion endpoint AND what concentration model you expect (push via HTTPS, pull via SFTP, or Splunk HEC).
> - confirm the minimum fields your auditors need for logs (we default to time, request_id, trace_id, model, user_id (hashed), level, message).

We will use Splunk HEC in our main audit environment. For backups the security team keeps an SFTP mirror for cold evidence. Auditors have asked for both an HEC sample and a static sample bundle they can download. Minimum fields: the list you provided is fine, but we also require an explicit host identifier and a marker for redacted PII (present/removed).

I've attached the audit scope doc so you can see redaction policy. If you can include a small example that shows a redacted versus raw (hashed) user id that will make the auditors happy.

I'll plan to upload your bundle to our evidence vault on Wed 2026‑05‑27.

Cheers,
Jake

Attachments: acme_audit_scope.docx (DOCX, 30KB)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Jake Morris <jake.morris@acme-finance.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability evidence and SIEM integration details for on‑prem Redwood deployment

Jake / Kim —

We uploaded the initial evidence bundle to the shared drive and added the HEC sample payloads and an SFTP static bundle. Contents included: 
- redwood_onprem_evidence_bundle_v1.zip (contains sample_logs/, sample_traces/, manifest.csv, checksums.txt)
- sample_hec_payload.json (batch of ~1,000 events with host_id and redaction markers)
- retention_and_routing_note.md (describes on‑box KV cache retention, adjustable TTLs, and egress routing options)

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq-sample-evidence (same as earlier)

Next steps and owners: 
- Acme security: confirm HEC token expiry and preferred SFTP location for the static bundle upload (action: Jake).
- Redwood (Diego): prepare a short MD that maps span fields to SIEM event fields and include a curl example for HEC ingestion (ETA 2026‑05‑28).
- Redwood (Hannah): finalize retention_and_routing_note.md with your comments (ETA 2026‑05‑28).

If the auditors want a signed manifest for chain of custody, we can produce a checksummed manifest and export a small PGP‑signed file — let me know.

Diego Fernandez
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Observability
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced in drive: redwood_onprem_evidence_bundle_v1.zip, sample_hec_payload.json, retention_and_routing_note.md
